lead: Every problem has a scarce resource: time, compute, ingredients, a team's attention. I name it first, then design around it. My core is embedded and kernel work, but I've worked across enough other fields to see solutions that people inside a single field tend to miss.

blocks.title: Embedded
blocks.anchor: Close to the hardware, where I started and where I'm most at home.
blocks.body: I began my career in embedded development, thrilled by how much visibility and control you have over your programs. Since then, I've built my skills in inter-process communication and device drivers, and contributed to both Zephyr and the Linux kernel.

blocks.title: Delivery
blocks.anchor: Taking products from idea to release.
blocks.body: I've guided projects the whole way through, with a hand in everything from specs and UI/UX to planning and keeping people coordinated. Building at startup pace gave me speed, grit and adaptability.

blocks.title: Learning
blocks.anchor: Always picking up something new, usually by building it.
blocks.body: Lately that's ESP32 projects, further contributions to Zephyr and a curiosity about the world of edge AI.
